requirement: The template page on /ops shows the road to live of each release, a failed demo install says why, and an EmDash demo or stock site with no owner sends mail from its relay address

oracle.ref: PR #1165 (feat); fix evidence: 11/10/2026, reviewing ja-restaurant on dev as a new admin: the Problems panel did not say where to start, a failed demo was invisible without a listing, and the NO_CONTRACT refusal pointed at a command that cannot capture an unpublished template. #827: EmDash demos failed at configure-mail with sender demo-sweep@tracy, stock sites with NO_SENDER.
oracle.invariant: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests; tsc exits 0. S1: road has seven steps in the order release, install-file, contract, demo, listing, published, polish, each {step, state, code, params, blockedBy?}; ja-restaurant on dev reads release ok, no contract (the one step to do), demo failed on 1.0.0 and blocked by contract, no listing and blocked by demo; an install file the door refuses holds contract, demo, listing and Publish. S1: a sweep-driven demo redeploy keeps the presser, never names demo-sweep@tracy as owner, and sends mailSender <label>@SITE_MAIL_DOMAIN; a stock EmDash instance carries its relay sender and names no owner; with no site mail domain no sender is invented. S1: a failed demo or stock build records the reason the host log gives (the configure-mail: line or the Joomla installer's error), never the generic refusal or the usage synopsis. S2: tracy-host passes mailSender to provision.sh as --mail-sender (no flag when absent); emdash.sh uses it only when there is no owner email; joomla.sh prints '!! installer: <message>' on a CLI installer failure. S3: every failed demo gets the two steps Press Retry install twice and Still failing? Send the reason to the dev team; a mail failure adds the fact line Fixed on 11/10/2026, so a retry should pass; any other reason adds none.
